items.title: Here's What Key Metrics Tell Us About HP (HPQ) Q3 Earnings
items.summary: Although the revenue and EPS for HP (HPQ) give a sense of how its business performed in the quarter ended July 2026, it might be worth considering how some key metrics compare with Wall Street estimates and the year-ago numbers.

items.title: HP (HPQ) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
items.summary: HP (HPQ) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +10.67% and +5.59%, respectively, for the quarter ended July 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: HP (NYSE:HPQ) Delivers Impressive Q2 CY2026 But Stock Drops
items.summary: Personal computing and printing company HP (NYSE:HPQ) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 12.5% year on year to $15.68 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.83 per share was 20% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: HP earnings beat expectations but shares tumble
items.summary: Investing.com -- HP Inc (NYSE:HPQ) reported third quarter results that exceeded analyst expectations, but shares fell over 9% in after-hours trading Wednesday as investors took profits following an 18.5% gain in the past month.

items.title: HP Revenue Rises as Higher Prices Offset Fewer PC Sales
items.summary: The printer and computer maker reported a profit of $661 million, or 71 cents a share, down from $763 million, or 80 cents a share, a year earlier.
